tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build release firmware and show size
args: source "$IDF_PATH/export.sh" >/dev/null && idf.py -B build-release -D IDF_TARGET=esp32s3 -D SDKCONFIG=build-release/sdkconfig -D SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS='sdkconfig.defaults;sdkconfig.defaults.release' build size

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build ESP32-P4-NANO firmware
args: source "$IDF_PATH/export.sh" >/dev/null && idf.py -B build-esp32p4 -D IDF_TARGET=esp32p4 -D SDKCONFIG=build-esp32p4/sdkconfig build

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build T-Dongle-S3 firmware
args: source "$IDF_PATH/export.sh" >/dev/null && idf.py -B build-tdongle-s3 -D IDF_TARGET=esp32s3 -D SDKCONFIG=build-tdongle-s3/sdkconfig -D SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS='sdkconfig.defaults;sdkconfig.defaults.tdongle-s3' build

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build T-Dongle-C5 firmware
args: source "$IDF_PATH/export.sh" >/dev/null && idf.py -B build-tdongle-c5 -D IDF_TARGET=esp32c5 -D SDKCONFIG=build-tdongle-c5/sdkconfig -D SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS='sdkconfig.defaults;sdkconfig.defaults.tdongle-c5' build
